plugins.description: Main thread plans and adjudicates; scout (haiku) maps and compresses; architect (opus) discusses architecture, writes Lane 2 specs, and root-causes hard bugs; builder (sonnet) implements; reviewer (sonnet) checks risk work; scribe (haiku) records.
